newsitem.title: UK: Express investing 10 mln stg on papers.
newsitem.headline: Express investing 10 mln stg on papers.

text.p: Express Newspapers said on Tuesday that it planned to invest some 10 million stg to improve the quality of its Daily and Sunday Express titles.
An Express spokesman said that the loss of some 85 jobs as part of its reorganisation was expected to cost the company in the region of six million stg.
